title: Fleet — Vehicle Rate Cards
notes: No relation fields (vehicleType/tripType are enums via Select, not RelationCombobox) and no phone/address/messaging fields, so those contract items are N/A rather than defects. detailDrawer omitted: rows navigate to the edit page instead, since no read-only detail page is in scope. Added edit page (new). list()/create()/update() still hit /fleet/rate-cards per existing colocated tests in fleet.test.ts, even though backend/src/routes/fleet.ts mounts the real handlers at /fleet/vehicle-rate-cards (P1 #75 area) -- left unchanged since config.ts and the base CRUD shape are out of this slice's fileAllowlist. Wired the two orphaned endpoints (lookup, estimate) as new fleetApi.rateCards.lookup/estimate functions for future use; no page in this slice calls them yet.
